name: Install uv
description: Astral's standalone installer for uv, the fast Python package and project manager.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Install uv
snippets.description: No Python needed first — uv ships its own.

steps.content:
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

# The installer writes to ~/.local/bin and updates your shell profile.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
uv --version
